title: Fancy UI registry item
description: The document served at /r/{name}.json: one component's full source bundle, which `npx fancy-cli@latest add <name>` writes into a project. Reference: https://ui.particle.academy/docs/registry

name.description: A registry item name: lower-case kebab-case, unique across the registry.

package.description: The Fancy package the item comes from. Informational: the bundle is self-contained.

dependencies.description: npm packages the item's source imports. Peer dependencies (react, react-dom, tailwindcss) are left out.

registryDependencies.description: Names of other items in this registry that the item imports. Consumers install them too, recursively.

files.description: The source files to write. Empty when the item is installed as a package rather than vendored.

path.description: The file's path inside the bundle.

target.description: Where the file lands. The CLI maps the `components/fancy/` prefix onto the project's configured components directory.

since.description: First kit version the item exists in. Absent: it has always been here.

until.description: Last kit version the item exists in. Absent: still current.
